title: Comparing two diagnostic tests on the same patients
summary: Paired comparison of two tests' AUCs by DeLong's test for correlated ROC curves, and of their sensitivities at a prespecified threshold by McNemar's test.

sizing._why: Comparing correlated AUCs or paired sensitivities needs the between-test correlation; no catalog form takes it.

pinned_defaults: Paired DeLong test (roc.test method = 'delong', paired = TRUE); the unpaired SE is reported beside it.
Sensitivities compared among patients with disease at a prespecified common threshold (0.6), McNemar without continuity correction, Wald interval for the paired difference.
Direction pinned for both markers: higher values mean disease.
_paired: Ignoring the pairing overstates the SE of the AUC difference when the markers are positively correlated (0.0165 against 0.0119 here); a two-proportion test on the sensitivities ignores it the same way.
